question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Have a good run

options.text: To experience joy or success in some endeavour, but only for a limited period of time

solution:
The correct answer is: **To experience joy or success in some endeavour, but only for a limited period of time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"Have a good run"** means to experience joy or success in some endeavour, but only for a limited period of time. (कुछ प्रयास में आनंद या सफलता का अनुभव करना, लेकिन केवल सीमित अवधि के लिए)

 
 
• **Example: **He had a good run in his career as a musician before retiring.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**
